scope: Selected MoveToCover completion, hold, return and cleanup branches. Not a complete FSM or source-tree review. Some long inspection outputs were truncated; no full-file review credit.

dispositions.intent: Retain useful cover while suppressed; distinguish reached, nearby and failed movement.
dispositions.observed: Reached cover forceSpeed0; nominal hold is capped15 seconds, but timeout requires suppression at or below skill for reached ordinary cover. Defensive reached cover has a separate leave predicate.
dispositions.decision: Retain suppression-sensitive tactical intent, but do not import an unbounded speed hold. CBE danger cover currently releases its finite movement marker on arrival without adding a forced hold.
dispositions.remaining: Trace CBE suppression and defensive-position owners before deciding whether a finite tactical hold is missing; no new controller is justified by this selected comparison alone.

dispositions.intent: Resume original movement when cover episode ends, while yielding to medical ownership.
dispositions.observed: Return branch compares waypoint indices and can issue doMove to saved GoPos if cycle and eligibility match.
dispositions.decision: Do not equate unchanged waypoint index with unchanged mission authority. CBE uses original route receipt, operation/epoch and actor goal checks; failed-approach return now retains the original formation anchor.

dispositions.intent: Reject stale episode cleanup and release movement/targeting modifications.
dispositions.observed: Cycle guard protects many writes, but cleanup resets forceSpeed and enables targeting/suppression/autocombat features rather than restoring individual saved feature baselines.
dispositions.decision: Retain episode identity and single cleanup ownership; do not import unconditional feature enablement or remembered-target replay over newer authority.
dispositions.remaining: Review all selected CBE cover/stance/target writers together before extending restoration. No runtime changes made by this review.

dispositions.observed: After repeated missing destinations, chooses a random position near leader.
dispositions.decision: Do not call an arbitrary fallback point cover. Required safe fallback remains subject to geometry, reachability and mission authority; failure may retire the finite attempt.

nextWork: Complete untruncated startup/move/cleanup inspection and actual callers, then compare suppression/defence ownership across CBE before selecting further runtime changes. Do not repeat the already committed anchor fix.

ranges: 1841-1930: defensive assignment, doFSM dispatch and subsequent buddy writes
callerTrace.limits: Selected caller regions only. Whole findCover function and buddy lifecycle not fully reviewed. Source startup/move and nil-exit blocks were read with quoted FSM strings decoded as text, never executed.

cbeFinding.issue: DangerSetup explicit cleanup invoked cover helper in normal service mode before generation invalidation. A still-enabled current cover lease could be retained rather than retired.
cbeFinding.fix: Pass existing releaseOnly=true. Existing helper then suppresses adoption, retention and failed-approach follow, removes only exact owned movement metadata, and retires matching pending assessment. No movement cancellation/teleport/AI-feature writes added.
